answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, like a deposit on a shop lease. A lone attacker standing on a knoll can afford one stake, but flooding the ocean of the market with thousands of fake raven identities means locking a fortune per clone, and each detected fake forfeits its bond. Honest agents pay nothing extra beyond the deposit, while Sybil farming becomes a money-losing business.
